summary: Built a consolidated 33-case matrix: 16 attack variants across link, image, video poster, form action, generic background and SVG link attributes, plus 17 allowed, relative, query-ampersand, non-ASCII, malformed, double-encoded and custom-protocol controls. Every case ran the sanitizer and then re-parsed each emitted URI attribute with the same HTML parser before checking the scheme. On the patched copy no attack case retained a URI attribute and no emitted value resolved to a blocked scheme; all 17 controls were byte-identical to the pristine output and none was blocked. Applying only the source-only patch to a fresh snapshot succeeded, the fresh matrix output was identical, and the fresh copy passed the full suite (256 tests, 2 expected failures) plus 22 focused entity-URI checks. The exported JSONL contains one source-only entry. Evidence strength: direct end-to-end local result with a clean-copy replay. Limitation: the official host-side benchmark evaluation was not available and remains unverified.
next_hint: Run the official external evaluator against the supplied patch JSONL and report its verdict separately from these local results.
